fieldValues.title: Presentation shapes (reference)
fieldValues.description: Pseudo-IDL for the shapes View, Composition and Theme are built from. Each is reference material for the mechanism that names it ("Example: the `X` shape"), collected under this single heading instead of scattered through the main line.
fieldValues.notes: Grouped by P6 (srs#807) under X1's reference-material treatment: these hand-authored shape blocks were previously scattered as flat siblings inside View and Theme, breaking the narrative with no connecting prose between them.
